entities.name: Margarita Gil Roësset
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Margarita Gil Roësset also known as Marga Gil Roësset, was a Spanish sculptor, illustrator, and poet. She is remembered for her sculptures in the genres of Art Nouveau, symbolism, and expressionism which were successfully exhibited at the National Exhibition of Fine Arts in Spain during her lifetime.
